body:
Phase 4 items 4.3 + 4.4 of docs/specs/pi-native-flush.md (READ IT FIRST). Builds on T26.

=== VERIFIED FACTS ===
- `pi.registerTool` contract as in T26. `pi.exec(cmd, args, {timeout?}) -> {stdout, stderr, code}`.
- The rails-aware gate-argv policy ALREADY EXISTS for opencode: plugins/adlc-opencode/rails-checker.mjs RAILS_SAFE_GATES + its adlc_gate policy (read it as the reference — that directory is FROZEN, port the policy semantics into plugins/adlc-pi, do not modify or import from the opencode plugin).
- Compaction: `session_before_compact` can supply a full CompactionResult (an LLM-generated summary we do NOT want to own) — instead this ticket implements a DETERMINISTIC defense: pi re-appends the ticket doctrine every turn already (Phase 1), so what compaction actually loses is OPEN GATE STATE. After a `session_compact` event, re-assert it: read the session's own 'adlc-gate-event' entries (ctx.sessionManager.getBranch()/getEntries()) plus the fitness/degraded flag, and sendMessage (deliverAs 'nextTurn') a compact digest of unresolved ADLC state (recent denies/reverts, degraded flag, active ticket) so the post-compaction context cannot lose enforcement history. Bound the digest (last 10 events, ≤ 1200 chars).

=== DELIVERABLES ===
1. `pi.registerTool('adlc_gate')`: params { gate: StringEnum([...the deterministic adlc gates...]), args?: string }. execute() enforces the ported argv policy BEFORE running: while a ticket is active, only rails-safe gates (port the opencode RAILS_SAFE_GATES set) run freely; every gate denies command-executor flags (--*cmd) and unvetted write-target flags per the reference policy; unknown gate → deny (fail closed; StringEnum already constrains, but the policy re-checks). Runs `adlc <gate> [argv...] --json` via pi.exec with a timeout, returns structured {code, stdout-parsed-JSON | raw} and renders exit 0/2 as pass/gate-fail. Gate runs record an 'adlc-gate-run' evidence entry (gate, exit code).
2. Post-compaction re-assertion (above): lib/compaction.mjs building the digest from session entries (pure, tested) + wiring on session_compact. Applies to ALL compaction reasons (manual included — state loss is state loss); the build-gate degraded marking stays threshold/overflow-only as shipped in T22.
3. Skills/templates touch-up: the adlc phase skills reference `adlc <tool>` shell invocations; add one line routing agents to prefer the adlc_gate tool when running inside pi (keep CLIs as the documented fallback).

=== ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA ===
- AC1: adlc_gate with a rails-safe gate (e.g. preflight) executes via the injected exec and returns parsed JSON + exit code; with a non-rails-safe gate while a ticket is active → denied with the policy reason; `--test-cmd`/any `--*cmd` flag → denied for every gate. VERIFY: node --test with fake exec.
- AC2: exit 2 from the CLI renders as a gate-fail result (isError false — a failing gate is a RESULT, not a tool error) with the parsed violations visible; exec timeout → tool error (throw). VERIFY: node --test.
- AC3: every adlc_gate run appends an 'adlc-gate-run' evidence entry (session + manifest, chain-valid). VERIFY: node --test.
- AC4: after a session_compact event, exactly one nextTurn digest message is sent when unresolved gate events exist in the session entries; a session with no ADLC events sends nothing; the digest is bounded (≤ 1200 chars, ≤ 10 events). VERIFY: wiring tests with a fake sessionManager.
- AC5: full root `npm test` exits 0; both live scripts (pi-live-deny, pi-live-prosecute) pass.

Suppressions denied; marker fixtures by concatenation. Do not modify sibling plugins or packages/**.
title: pi Phase 4b: native adlc_gate tool (rails-aware argv policy) + post-compaction ADLC state re-assertion
